answers.core: I don't believe this can be an add-on since the RPC networking is tightly integrated into the engine.
answers.workaround: There is a work around as shown above. However, it is far more than a few lines of code. And note that because the rpc_id call and the callback are decoupled, additional logic must be added to detect the failure to receive a response to the requests.

title: Support returning values from `rpc_id()` calls or add something like `rpc_id_with_return()`
